comment: Claude Code Code Mode PostToolUse events for #599. Each tool_response has the shape Claude Code 2.1.330 sent to a live hook; the nonce, time and code are stand-ins. {{SECRET}} becomes the planted marker when the test runs, so no literal here looks like a credential. A case whose `masked` is true carries the marker and must come back with only that value replaced and the shape unchanged; one whose `masked` is false is clean and the hook must print nothing, which also keeps a Poll event's nonce intact. Codex has no REPL or Poll tool and its manifests do not list them, so its rows only show that the handler treats such an event like any other tool output.
